title: Google Privacy Policy Update Affects Gmail Ad Targeting
excerpt: Google's updated privacy policy indicates that enabling Personal Intelligence allows the company to use Gmail data for ad targeting.
body_html:
Google has updated its privacy policy with changes regarding how user data may be utilized for advertising purposes. According to the updated terms, activating the Personal Intelligence feature gives the company access to more user data specifically for ad targeting.

The policy adjustment outlines how specific features interact with data collection practices across Google services. Users who choose to enable Personal Intelligence should expect their Gmail content to contribute to the data pool used for delivering targeted advertisements.
